classes.title: 正常工具事务
classes.script: 模型先返回一次 write_file 调用，再返回终态文本；工具与进程走真实实现，只有模型流由脚本提供。
classes.expected: 三协议请求投影与历史角色闭合，目标文件写入，宿主快照展示工具事务。

evidence.marker: runs one real tool transaction over %s and consumes every scripted turn
runs a real one-shot tool transaction through CliModelBindings without environment keys
serves a redacted snapshot, deduplicates operation IDs, and consumes every scripted turn

classes.title: 多工具部分失败
classes.script: 同一批返回成功写入与越界写入两个调用，沙箱拒绝越界项后继续收尾。
classes.expected: 成功项真实落盘、越界项成为错误 tool_result，历史无悬挂调用且不产生外部文件。

evidence.marker: closes a partial multi-tool batch with one real failure and no outside write

classes.title: 执行取消
classes.script: 模型流保持开启并已输出部分文本，运行方在 text_delta 期间中止。
classes.expected: 在途请求关闭、运行处于 aborted、会话释放且历史只保留用户消息；宿主保持 cancelling 直到清理完成。

evidence.marker: aborts a held model stream and leaves no uncommitted assistant history
keeps a cancelling run busy until its iterator completes cleanup
disconnect clears control after a busy cleanup without waiting on a rejected run

classes.title: 消费者提前 return
classes.script: 模型流按两个文本分片输出，消费者在第一个分片后 break。
classes.expected: 迭代器返回触发取消与清理，busy 释放、运行标记 aborted，未完成的 assistant 文本不进入历史。

evidence.marker: releases the session when the consumer returns before the stream finishes
records interrupted terminal after iterator return and waits before releasing busy state

classes.title: 审批拒绝/超时/断线
classes.script: 写入工具需要审批，分别注入 deny_once、对端超时/中止以及非交互输入。
classes.expected: 拒绝以 PERMISSION_DENIED 错误事务闭合、不再追问模型且目标文件不存在；超时与断线回落为拒绝并清理审批控制。

evidence.marker: records a denied approval as a closed error transaction without touching the file
settles an uncooperative peer on timeout, abort and dispose
denies non-interactive requests
cancels a pending approval on abort

classes.title: 崩溃恢复
classes.script: 在工具开始前与审批决策后分别模拟进程崩溃，再按落盘历史恢复会话。
classes.expected: 未完成调用恢复为 OUTCOME_UNKNOWN 且不重放工具；已完成调用保持闭合，重启与压缩后事务不重复写入。

evidence.marker: treats both pre-start and post-decision crashes as unknown, but leaves finished calls closed
A tools → B → resume A → compact → restart A preserves transactions and never replays writes

classes.title: 子代理取消/collect
classes.script: 父运行创建子代理后分别注入父级取消与子代理空闲完成，再收集结果。
classes.expected: 取消级联到全部后代并释放资源；空闲完成只收集一次结果，不重复消费待处理值。

evidence.marker: cascades cancellation to all descendants when parent is cancelled
observes idle-parent completion without consuming the pending result

classes.title: 技能权限收紧
classes.script: 技能通过多次限制叠加收紧白名单，并复用缓存审批尝试越权读取。
classes.expected: 多重限制取交集，缓存审批不能扩大范围；Plan 下仅真实控制读取放行，宿主拒绝仍然生效。

evidence.marker: intersects multiple restrictions and refuses white-list escape even with cached approvals
allows genuine skill control reads in Plan but preserves a host deny

classes.title: MCP 撤销/teardown
classes.script: 在工具发送前撤销 MCP 授权，并对同一连接重复执行 teardown。
classes.expected: 撤销产出 not_sent 且零发送请求；teardown 幂等，不重复释放或破坏后续关闭。

evidence.marker: R15: 贯穿 Core ToolExecutor 全链路，发送前撤销产出 dispatchOutcome: not_sent 且零发送
teardown is fully idempotent

classes.title: 压缩失败
classes.script: 摘要已生成但提交失败；另一种情况是受保护内容本身已超出预算。
classes.expected: 提交失败不激活摘要也不计成功，原历史不被替换；受保护内容超预算时停止压缩且不调用摘要模型。

evidence.marker: does not activate a generated summary or count success when its commit fails
stops when protected content alone exceeds budget without calling a summary model

classes.title: 慢客户端/大快照
classes.script: 宿主生成大逻辑快照并按游标分块，客户端读取缓慢或在安装前超出连接内存预算。
classes.expected: 大快照分块且游标可校验；超预算快照被明确拒绝，attach 回滚控制状态而不是部分安装。

evidence.marker: chunks a large logical snapshot and validates session/revision cursors
refuses snapshots beyond the connection memory budget
rolls back control when the attach snapshot exceeds the connection budget

classes.title: 操作 ID 去重/跨增量凭证脱敏
classes.script: 同一 clientOperationId 重放同一输入，再以改动输入重试；模型分片把凭证拆到多个增量中。
classes.expected: 重放返回同一 runId 且不新增模型请求，改动输入报 OPERATION_CONFLICT；跨增量凭证在事件流与快照中均被替换，原始密钥不出现。

evidence.marker: serves a redacted snapshot, deduplicates operation IDs, and consumes every scripted turn
deduplicates accepted operations and rejects changed inputs
